name: Advisory Speed plaque
spec: yellow square plaque with black numerals 35 and legend M.P.H.
meaning: The safe speed for the curve or hazard above this plaque.

snippets.back: A curve or winding-road advisory calls for adjusting speed to the stated advisory speed.
An advisory speed sign gives the top safe speed for taking the turn ahead.
Advisory speed signs are cautionary signs giving the safe speed for curves, corners and off-ramps under ideal conditions.
An advisory speed is distinct from a statutory limit, but exceeding it can still violate the reasonable-speed rule for the conditions.
An advisory speed is not a specific limit, but exceeding it and crashing can support a finding that the general speed restriction was violated.
At a single-lane roundabout, slow to the advisory speed, stop for pedestrians at the approach crosswalk and wait for an opening in circulating traffic.
A rectangular sign can show a regulation such as a speed limit, helpful information such as a route marker, or a hazard warning such as an advisory speed for a sharp curve.
A roundabout warning sign means slow to the advisory speed as you approach and be ready to stop.
